name: Point & Click / Escape Room
description: Look at everything, take what moves, and work out what goes with what. The pack is organised around the genre's two historical failures. Pixel-hunting is answered by world.hotspot_layer, which offers a highlight-all key and reports hotspots that are exhausted, so a stuck player is never re-searching solved ground. Moon logic is answered by inventory.inventory_combine's refusal lines: a rule may say why it does not apply, and a specific refusal teaches where a generic shrug does not. world.puzzle_lock_chain makes the room a dependency graph rather than a list, which is what lets it publish a frontier of currently-solvable locks -- the single query that separates a player who is stuck from one who is lost.
loop: examine scene → collect clues → combine → unlock next space

signatureCompound.name: The Rope, The Hook, The Door
signatureCompound.description: Three components and a graph: hotspot_layer offers the rope with a take cursor and reports the hook as usable, inventory_combine accepts rope-on-hook in either order and produces a grapple, puzzle_lock_chain sees its condition met and opens the door -- publishing a new frontier as it does, which narrative_journal records under the thread the player was already following.
